chat.welcome:
Hey—I’m here to surprise you with historical toys and games from this catalog. We’ll chat a little so I learn what you like, then I’ll suggest matches. You can also ask how to play, where a game comes from, cultural variations, or purchase options.

To start: how many people will usually play?
chat.outOfScope: In Ludus Atlas maneo—crepundia et ludos invenire, quomodo operentur, contextum culturalem, quomodo ludatur, ubi emantur. In hac via roga, aut dic “denuo incipe” ut praeferentias reformes.
chat.askSetting: Intellexi. Ludus mensae intra, extra/activus, an utrumlibet?
chat.askRegion: Regio aut civitas ad quam inclinas? (aut dic ubique)
chat.hint.preference: Say a preference, ask about a game, or tap a quick reply—I’ll guide you from there.
chat.hint.players: Nice chatting—still need a group size so I can aim right. Alone, 2, 3–4, a larger group, or any?
chat.hint.setting: Got it. Next step: indoor table play, outdoor/active play, or either? Tap a reply or tell me in your own words.
chat.hint.vibe: Almost there—what vibe fits you best? Strategy, casual, craft, sport, puzzle… or just say “surprise me.”
chat.askAbout: Nomina ludum e catalogo et originem historiamque communicabo.
chat.askVariations: Nomina ludum et variationes culturales enumerabo.
chat.askHowToPlayWhich: Quem ludum doceam? Nomina, aut de una commendationum supra roga.
chat.askRequirements: Cuius ludi requisita aut numerum lusorum inspiciam?
chat.askCompare: Nomina duos ludos catalogi ad comparandum (e.g. “compara Go et Latrunculos”).
chat.rec.none: Fortem congruentiam non inveni{prefLine}. Regionem ad “quamlibet” dilata, aut dic “denuo incipe”.
